caption: The drawing features a square textile design with a predominantly dark blue background and a repeating pattern composed of off-white or cream-colored geometric shapes. The off-white elements form a grid of horizontal and vertical bands that intersect toward the center, creating a series of rectangular and square shapes. Around the edges, the off-white pattern forms partial rectangular outlines and corner embellishments, while the center of the design features a denser grid with multiple horizontal and vertical bands intersecting. The pattern creates a symmetrical, woven or stitched appearance, suggesting a textile or fabric motif. The artwork is centered on a plain, light-colored background with no additional objects or decorations.
